snip.t: Mycoplasma pneumoniae is common in atypical pneumonia, but S. pneumoniae remains the most frequent overall bacterial cause.
While Mycoplasma pneumoniae is a common atypical cause, pneumococcus remains the most frequent overall bacterial etiology.

Infection is the most well-known etiology, yet only 30% of ACS episodes will have positive sputum or bronchoalveolar culture, and the most common bacterial pathogens are S. pneumoniae, Mycoplasma pneumoniae, and Chlamydia spp.
d) The commonest causative organism is Mycoplasma pneumoniae
CAP: Streptococcus pneumoniae (commonest), *Haemophilus influenzae*, *Mycoplasma pneumoniae*, *Legionella*, *Chlamydophila*, viruses (influenza, RSV, SARS-CoV-2)
